method: Built-in image_gen concept exploration, then a native SVG redraw and a separate 16px optical drawing.
final_image_prompt: Edit this image into a genuinely compact BRAND EMBLEM. Keep the relaxed vintage travel-print sensibility, the blue tennis court in three-quarter perspective, the green land, and the sun as a tennis ball. Radically simplify: remove ALL trees, trunks, buildings, flowers, leaves, cypresses, bushes, islands, distant houses, and all net mesh. Remove textures and gradients. No vegetation or architecture whatsoever. Leave only THREE visual subjects: 1) ONE broad green horizon curve, 2) ONE lime sun with ONE elegant negative-space tennis seam, 3) ONE blue court below it with only 5 to 7 white strokes showing the outer lines and simple net. This must be a small elegant symbol recognizable on a luggage tag, not a scenic illustration or travel poster. Clean flat vector-like filled shapes with smooth curves, restrained craftsmanship. Aim for the simplicity of a classic airline emblem, with warm travel-guide personality. Compact near-circular overall composition. All shapes have broad weight and generous negative space. Sun about one third of overall width, not half. Entire emblem centered with at least 15% empty warm ivory margin on all sides. No text, no initials, no captions, no badges, no app tile. Retain blue #2d5d8c, green #3a6e52, lime #dcf343 on warm ivory.
outputs: The SVGs are the deliverable master artwork. illustrated-reference.png preserves the image-generation concept.
